newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Martinair signs two inter-line agreements.
newsitem.headline: Martinair signs two inter-line agreements.

text.p: Martinair Holland NV, the airfreight to passenger charter airline, has signed two new inter-line agreements, a Martinair spokesman said.
The airline, jointly owned by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV and Nedlloyd, said it signed an agreement effective March 1 with African Cargo Services (ACS) of Nairobi.
The agreement paves the way for ACS to deploy a Boeing 727 freighter from Nairobi to carry airfreight transported by Martinair on its four times weekly service to a variety of African destinations.

The second inter-line agreement is with STAF Airlines of Argentina, he said, adding that the deal extends to allow the south American airline to lease a Martinair MD-11 freighter for two flights a week.

"STAF will fly cargo which arrives in Miami on our weekly MD 11 freighter flight as well as transporting some of the airfreight which we carry in the belly of our passenger schedule to Miami," the Martinair official said.

"However, we have also leased the MD 11 to them for two flights a week," he added. Martinair's MD-11 freighter remains in Miami for a week after its regular weekly flight ex-Schiphol. During that time Martinair deploys the aircraft to a variety of destinations. The Argentine airline will have access to it for two flights during that period.
